Folded into fz-kdt.34.

Formula identity, exact revision/generation causes, changed output keys, and downstream wakes are one observability contract for scheduler and product work. They are exposed from the engines' authoritative state, not through an activation-specific ledger.

fz-kdt.13 consumes that generic signal. No independent implementation remains here.
title: Folded: work identity and causality belong to generic telemetry
